note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: CNBC Daily Open: Is the AI sector losing its rose-colored glow?
items.blurb: Twenty major AI and chip stocks shed over $1 trillion this week as CoreWeave credit stress and rate fears grew.

items.title: Fed's Warsh withholds rate signal, says AI's development path will be 'very bumpy'
items.blurb: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh called AI the most consequential economic change of his lifetime, while warning the transition may be rough.

items.title: AI 'espionage' is a reality that companies need to be 'wary of,' DNI Jay Clayton says
items.blurb: The intelligence director warns of foreign spying on AI labs after a Saudi national was charged with bugging an OpenAI conference room.

items.title: I watched Nvidia's Jensen Huang work the room in London. He brought big checks — and a blunt message
items.blurb: Nvidia's chief pairs new UK investment with a push for US-China cooperation on monitoring AI risks.

items.title: Here's how the CoreWeave sell-off is affecting OpenAI vs. Anthropic valuations
items.blurb: OpenAI's implied valuation briefly slipped under $1.5 trillion while Anthropic's rose past $2 trillion as neocloud stocks fell.

items.title: SpaceX AI policy leader grilled by NYC Council on Grok safety, sexualized images
items.blurb: New York City lawmakers questioned a SpaceX AI policy leader about Grok's safeguards and sexualized images.

items.title: Warsh signals steady Fed outlook despite inflation jump
items.blurb: The Fed chair called the AI investment surge probably the most important upside force in the global economy.

items.title: Analysis: Everyone expects the Fed to hold rates in October. Kevin Warsh could surprise us all
items.blurb: Higher borrowing costs would raise the price of the AI data-center buildout, which investors are already questioning.

items.title: Nasdaq slides 2% Friday to post worst week since June, pressured by AI sell-off and oil prices
items.blurb: The Nasdaq lost more than 4% on the week as investors rotated out of AI stocks over funding costs.

items.title: Roundtables: A Conversation With the Creator of AI-Designed Viruses
items.blurb: The Stanford researcher who used a generative model to design working viral genomes discusses what the work does and does not show.

items.title: Anything not tied to artificial intelligence took off this week
items.blurb: Non-AI stocks beat the market by the widest margin in nearly three years as twenty major AI and chip stocks lost over $1 trillion.

items.title: NBA tightens betting rules, develops AI to flag suspicious wagers
items.blurb: The league built an AI platform to spot suspicious betting patterns, an early major-sports use of AI for integrity enforcement.

items.title: SK Hynix shares plunge 10% amid Asia tech rout as Fed rate hike fears, AI funding worries mount
items.blurb: The chip sell-off deepened in Asia as investors questioned how the AI infrastructure buildout will be financed at higher interest rates.

items.title: Anthropic's third-quarter revenue is said to hit $16.8 billion ahead of IPO
items.blurb: Anthropic told investors revenue rose from about $11.6 billion in Q2 and said it was profitable on an adjusted basis.

items.title: TSMC posts record profit for a sixth straight quarter, beating estimates on AI boom
items.blurb: The chipmaker behind most AI accelerators beat profit forecasts, a counterweight to this week's AI infrastructure sell-off.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang urges U.S.-China dialogue on 'potentially dangerous' AI
items.blurb: Huang says Nvidia must work with Chinese AI researchers on monitoring risks, backing dialogue between the two countries' labs.

items.title: Anthropic makes an AI bull case with $16.8B sales, positive cash flow
items.blurb: Anthropic told investors it was cash-flow positive in the third quarter, offering evidence frontier AI can sustain itself amid bubble fears.

items.title: Scoop: The FTC demanded documents from AI giants over recent safety incidents
items.blurb: The FTC sent 50-page civil subpoenas to OpenAI and Anthropic over security incidents, safeguards, marketing and privacy practices.

items.title: Scoop: "OG" Bill Gates returns to wage war on AI risks
items.blurb: Gates plans a larger AI safety push, citing fast capability gains, security incidents and weak regulation.

items.title: CoreWeave roils the markets, raises warning flag for the AI trade
items.blurb: CoreWeave bond yields topped 15% for a second day, a warning sign for debt-funded AI infrastructure.

items.title: Amazon launches new Bee 'personal AI' devices that listen to conversations
items.blurb: Amazon unveiled two always-listening Bee devices that record, transcribe and summarize conversations, at $75 and $100.

items.title: NYC Comptroller Mark Levine on calling for Anthropic IPO pause: We need more caution & transparency
items.blurb: New York City's comptroller asked Anthropic to postpone its planned IPO, citing AI safety and transparency concerns.

items.title: Nvidia, Apple, Broadcom in 'fierce' battle to get chip manufacturing space at TSMC
items.blurb: AI chip demand is straining TSMC capacity as Nvidia, Apple, AMD and Broadcom compete for production lines.

items.title: Apple and Meta team up to make Muse AI model run on Mac computers
items.blurb: Meta's 816B open-weight Muse Spark Open can run locally on linked Mac Studios, an alternative to cloud GPUs.
